document_title: AIDEA's Fiber Tool and NuCube Stake, Cut Open
post_copy:
AIDEA called two very different things an "investment" on October 21st.

What does it mean for fiber? Up to $75 million all-in. Any binding deal carries at least eight conditions. Fiber pairs must land in Alaska. Signing authority ends December 31st, 2028 unless extended.

What does it mean for NuCube? $25 million in shares at $9.25, with half a warrant each at $11.50. The stake counts toward a different $75 million, NuCube's merger cash condition. No Alaska site, utility, customer or date is named.

Where does AI come in? The fiber resolution never mentions AI or data centers. NuCube's filing cites AI data center energy demand.

Eight conditions drawn as cable armor, four subsea cables by age, a NuCube price ladder and both checks side by side.

Should the rule that makes fiber land here also make the next equity stake name an Alaska site?

#AIDEA #SubseaFiber #Microreactors

Know the October 21st meeting or the NuCube terms better than the documents show? Add that context below.

slides.headline: $75 million behind eight locks. $25 million at $9.25 a share.
Eight conditions wrap any deal.
slides.body: Up to $75 million, all-in, cost overruns and capital calls included. Memoranda and forecasts don't count as customers.
labels: (vii) INVESTMENT DECISION BY A SET DATE

slides.headline: At the core, glass that has to come ashore.
slides.body: Every investment must deliver fiber pairs or capacity that physically land in Alaska and can be used there. A binding deal must also set a minimum number of landing pairs, with defined capacity and access rights.

slides.headline: Alaska has four subsea cables to the Lower 48. Two date from 1999.
slides.body: The resolution puts a subsea system's typical design life at about 25 years. None of the systems landing in Alaska connects directly to Asia.
labels: RUST ARC, YEARS IN SERVICE AGAINST A 25-YEAR DESIGN LIFE

slides.headline: "The routes chosen in the next few years will last for decades."
labels: THE RESOLUTION PICKS NO PROJECT, ROUTE OR PARTNER

slides.headline: Same day, $25 million for a reactor company.
slides.body: AIDEA announced a $25 million equity investment in NuCube Energy. Its NuSun platform is built around a solid-state, heat-pipe-cooled microreactor. AIDEA's release names no Alaska site, utility, customer or deployment date.
labels: GENERIC HEAT-PIPE ANATOMY, NOT NUCUBE'S DRAWING

slides.headline: The $25 million buys shares, not a reactor.
slides.body: Class A shares at $9.25, about 14.5 percent under the $10.82 reference price. It counts toward NuCube's $75 million minimum cash to close its merger. NuCube's filing cites AI data center energy demand. The fiber resolution never does.

slides.headline: The two checks, side by side.
labels: A finance plan and eight conditions
Never mentions AI or data centers
Filing cites AI data center demand

slides.headline: Should AIDEA's next equity check carry locks like the fiber money?
labels: AIDEA'S BOARD MEETS NEXT ON NOVEMBER 4TH
